title: Unintended Impacts of LLM Alignment on Global Representation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring performance disparity on a dialogue intent prediction task (MD3) across three varieties of English: US American, Nigerian, and Indian English.

Evaluating multilingual capabilities by measuring performance on extractive question answering (TyDiQA) and reading comprehension (Belebele) across nine typologically diverse languages compared to English.

Measuring the alignment of model responses with public opinion surveys from different countries (GlobalOpinionsQA) and analyzing reward model rankings of countries based on counterfactual preference questions (AskReddit dataset).
